result.title: Probabilistic Simulation of Gas-Liquid Interfaces with Coupled Flow Matching on Spherical Harmonics
result.summary: Bubbly flows involve strongly coupled bubble motion, deformation, and hydrodynamic interactions, making high-fidelity simulation computationally expensive. We propose a neural surrogate that jointly predicts bubble trajectories and interface deformation in a compact, shared representation, replacing costly mesh-resolved simulation with fast generative inference. Because two-phase flow dynamics is nonlinear and chaotic, we treat forecasting as a conditional generative problem rather than deterministic regression, predicting entire future windows in a single pass. We train and evaluate the surrogate on BubbleSH, a Front-Tracking dataset of rising deformable bubble swarms, assessing performance using trajectory, shape, and distributional metrics over kinematic, morphological, and interaction-based properties. The surrogate reproduces key flow statistics while running several orders of magnitude faster than the underlying DNS solver.

AI.brief_summary: 提出球谐函数表示与耦合 flow matching 结合的神经代理模型，把气泡群轨迹与界面形变放在共享紧凑表示中联合预测，以条件生成方式一次输出整段未来窗口，并在 BubbleSH 上按轨迹、形状与分布指标评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享紧凑潜在表示＋单次并行生成整段状态」的设定，与 LVR 中多实体几何关系信息如何在内部状态保留、以及并行生成而非 AR 逐步生成的路线可能有概念相通之处，供核查；但该工作属流体仿真远域，迁移可行性尚需验证。
